passages.text: Give someone the same benefit of doubt you give yourself

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Ask someone about their experience without assuming it matches yours

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: When you feel something strongly, ask: 'What's the actual evidence?'

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: When urge to distract arises, wait 30 seconds and name what you're avoiding

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Turn off all non-essential notifications for one day

passages.heading: Dissolution path

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: In any situation, find 3 things that are beautiful or safe

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Close all tabs. Start fresh with just what you need NOW.

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: When past pulls you, feel your feet on the ground — you're HERE

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Spend 10 minutes with attention fully on YOUR experience, not others'

passages.heading: Dissolution path

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Set 3 daily reminders to do a 30-second body check-in

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Notice 3 moments of unexpected beauty today

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Spend one social interaction focused on YOUR feelings, not theirs

passages.heading: Dissolution path

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: When emotionally charged, ask: 'What am I NOT seeing right now?'

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: Give full attention to something 'unproductive' for 20 minutes

passages.heading: Dissolution path
passages.text: In one conversation, listen without preparing any response
